spans.s: Aniketŏs (IE 8-2), Greek; royal title; ‘unopposed’; translated into Prakrit as Apadihata (Sanskrit Apratihata).
animeṣ-ānokaha (EI 4), same as sura-druma, i. e. kalpa-vṛkṣa.
Anivartaka-nivartayitṛ (CII 4), ‘repeller of the unrepellable’; title of a ruler.
aniyukta (IA 9), cf. niyukt-āniyukta-rājapuruṣa; probably refers to officials of the king, who were not actually appointed by the government, but occupied posts by virtue of heredity or election.
anniyāya-vāva-daṇḍa-ir̤ai (SITI), Tamil-Sanskrit; penal tax imposed on some unauthorised item of occupation or enjoyment.
